messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-4762 fired for service "model-serving" — incoming event source: "data-ingest". Routing tag: `ingest-prod`. Possible routing/schedule mismatch.

pagerduty-bot: Incident details: PD-4762
- Trigger: high error rate (5xx) on /ingest/batch
- Raw payload: `{"source":"ingest","tags":["ingest-prod","priority:high"]}`
- Routed to service: model-serving (integration key: xxxx-xxxx-xxxx)

sarah: I just got the page for model-serving — but the error path is ingest. not my stack.
kevin: same. duplicate pages popped to both teams for me and sarah.
devon: i'm on-call for model-serving and this looks like an ingest issue. do we have a routing rule that matches tags first?

maria: looking. grabbing PD rules now, i'll post a quick diff.

maria: snippet from PD rules console:
```
if payload.tags contains "ingest-prod" -> route to service: model-serving  # legacy entry
if payload.source == "ingest" -> route to service: data-ingest-prod
```
So there's a legacy tag-based rule that takes precedence for some events. that's the duplicate.

sarah: ugh, legacy rule. can someone ack model-serving so customers don't get paged twice?

devon: acked (manual) :white_check_mark:
kevin: acked as well, silencing until we fix routing.

maria: i'm disabling the legacy tag rule now and adding a safer check (explicit source match). applying patch via PD API:
```
curl -X PUT "https://api.pagerduty.com/rules/legacy-tag-route" \n  -H "Authorization: Token token=REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

oncall-bot: Detected overlapping schedule entry: "ingest-primary" and "model-serving-primary" both reference rotation policy `legacy-handoff` between 03:00-04:00 UTC. This can cause ambiguous routing during handoffs.

maria: discovered root cause: earlier migration created a temporary mapping (tag -> model-serving) and it was never removed. that mapping matched a high-volume ingest alert and routed it incorrectly.

sarah: is there any customer impact? logs?
kevin: checked metrics: ingest 5xx spike lasted ~37s at 2026-11-12T13:21:08Z -> 13:21:45Z. ~120 requests failed. no persistent degradation after routing fix.

maria: rolled change, sending a test event now.

pagerduty-bot: Test event routed to service: data-ingest-prod (success)

maria: ok tests look good. re-enabled stricter rule set: prefer explicit `source` matches, remove tag-only fallback. also added a guard: tag-only routes require `route_override: true` flag to be active.

devon: thanks. i've removed the manual silence on model-serving and cleared the ack. no further pages from PD for this event type.

sarah: next actions: create a small post-incident audit of PD routing rules and search for other tag->service legacy entries, and add a runbook note about preferring `source` over tags. can someone own?

kevin: i'll own the runbook & audit. putting a blocker in our backlog.

maria: filing a short incident summary. will include timeline, PD rule diff, and customer impact numbers. also scheduling a weekly PD routing review to prevent sticky overrides.

ops-bot: Paging suppression: model-serving suppressed for 1h to avoid noisy duplicates.

sarah: thanks all. moving follow-up to #postmortems and #eng-infra for the routing audit.

incident-bot: Incident PD-4762 resolved (routing fix applied). Closing thread.
